text_block_list.text: We came to a hot spring inn for Wonder Acute to get some rest... however.
choice_data_list: (I need to at least get this much work done...!)

text_block_list.text:
Every day up to this point has truly gone by in the blink of an eye.
...Yes, next year will be here before we know it.

The Classic Year—I must deliver results there.
I have to make them see the fruits of my labor...!
choice_data_list: (So I need to practice what I can while I still have time!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you're still working hard, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It was so pretty outside.
Trainer, why don't we take a walk for a breather?
choice_data_list: Thanks, but I'd really rather get it done right now.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even so, just a little bit. Just for a short while.
Won't you come hang out with me and take it easy?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come on now, let's get changed.
Today, we're gonna kick back and relax in the hot spring town~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Which hot spring sounds good to you?
For relieving fatigue, beautifying skin... There are all sorts, you know~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...And, I'm lookin' forward to the food too.
Oh right, you wanna eat some hot spring eggs too?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Trainer, are you thinking
about work again~?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Mister Wind.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"It's the 'Tales of Edo Warmth: Vagabond's Wind' series!
Look, over at that theater! That huge poster!"

Following their gaze, a poster for a long-running period drama movie
comes into view. It appears to be the 30th entry in the franchise.
choice_data_list: It's been going on for quite a long time, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I know. Trainer,
let's go watch that movie. Pretty please?"
Prompted by Wonder Acute, I ended up going along with her to watch a long-running period drama...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thank goodness.
It went great this time too~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "Always wandering aimlessly, laughing things off. But when it's time to decide, bam, she nails it...!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All 30 films, I never get tired of watching them.
Kaze-san really is wonderful...!
choice_data_list: No wonder you're still so beloved by the fans.
No wonder you're still so beloved by the fans, huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Right? I think so too~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but you see...
I'm pretty sure the release was delayed once,
back on the 15th installment~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, a staff member collapsed.
Up until then, it had been opened to the public every year, but..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It must be tough keeping it up every year.
You have to start making the next one while still working on the current one, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
To make it in time for the release...
everyone worked themselves frantically to the bone.
And that's why they collapsed, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I must have pushed myself too hard...
and because of that, I couldn't make the movie anymore.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...And so, they stopped keeping it open to the public every year. They started making sure to schedule regular breaks.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And look at the result.
It's been loved by everyone, and that's why it's survived all this time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "I'm glad we could take another look. It's really wonderful that we noticed something so important."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: I kind of get what you're trying to say.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yeah, is that so. Is that so.

She gently takes my hand while nodding,
stroking the back of it again and again—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Feeling rushed is proof that you're trying your hardest.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But you know, in order to run for a long time,
sometimes you have to deliberately come to a stop.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to rush for results.
The most important thing is "not giving up." ...Right?
choice_data_list: Still, sometimes I just want to rush...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to rush for results.
The most important thing is "not giving up." ...Right?
choice_data_list: Still, sometimes I just want to rush...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my, goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, indeed...
Pacing and rhythm are crucial in the racing world, after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
When resting, do it properly and leisurely.
Take your time to rest deeply.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"To make up for that, when it's time to fire up,
punch, punch, and punch!!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...In short, you just need to learn how to switch gears.
Fufufu. Don't worry, we'll learn together, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well.
Look who's saying things like that?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Can't be helped, then. I'll show you how it's done,
so have some crunchy snacks for now~."

The salty-sweet flavor of the crunchy snack
felt even stronger than usual...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you understand, then you'll be fine.
All that's left is to take your time getting used to it...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Accu-san and the others.
Yahallo.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Did ya come to watch a movie too?
Me too. It's great they're showin' older films
from the 'Rampaging Monster' series here.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, ufufu.
That one's a 'long-running' monster movie franchise too, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, they're showing the episode with that
jidaigeki actor you like, Accu-san.
Care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, myyy...!
Trainer, how about just one more stick to unwind, hm...?
choice_data_list: Got it, guess this counts as a breather exercise too.
Got it, guess this is a nice little breather exercise too!

text_block_list.text:
Without overthinking, I just enjoyed the kaiju movie.
For now, simply to prepare for the next step forward—
